title: sdkgen compat --format json report
description: Draft-2020-12 schema for the exact JSON object CompatibilityReportRenderer.render(report, JSON) emits (generator/cli/src/main/kotlin/com/nabobery/sdkgen/cli/CompatibilityReportRenderer.kt, CompatibilityReport.toJson()). Derived from real `sdkgen compat --format json` invocations against committed manifests, not written ahead of the renderer. The renderer emits compact single-line JSON (kotlinx.serialization's COMPACT_JSON); this schema does not imply pretty-printing. Field order in this document follows toJson()'s emission order but JSON objects are unordered, so a consumer must not depend on key order. This schema describes ADR 0013's report contract as currently implemented; it is not itself part of the frozen ADR text and must be kept in sync with the renderer rather than read as a second source of truth.

aggregateOutcome.description: Derived, never renderer-selected (ADR 0013, 'Classification and aggregate outcome'). incomplete if any of the 5 layers is unavailable or any change is unknown; compatible if all 5 layers are unchanged and there are no changes; changed otherwise.

totalChangeCount.description: Count of the full, untruncated change set (not just displayed rows).

changeCountsByClassification.description: Sparse map: only classifications with a nonzero count are present. Absent key means zero, not unknown.

mostSevereClassification.description: Classification of changes[0] after severity-then-change-ID sort, or null when there are no changes. Severity order (most to least severe): breaking, unknown, behaviorallyRisky, additive.

truncation.description: Present only when maximumDisplayedChanges hid rows. Absence means every change is displayed. Truncation can never hide a breaking, unknown, or incomplete-causing layer -- it only reduces how many change rows print.

layers.description: Always exactly 5 entries, one per canonical layer, in ADR 0013's canonical order: sourceContract, semanticModel, kotlinApi, behavior, abi.

changes.description: Displayed changes only (see truncation), sorted by severity then by full change ID. totalChangeCount/changeCountsByClassification/mostSevereClassification are computed from the full set, not this array.

code.description: Stable machine-readable reason code. Observed in real corpus reports today: missing-layer-evidence (sourceContract/semanticModel/kotlinApi/abi -- no v1alpha2 digest, or no staged ABI dump, present in the manifest), missing-behavior-evidence (behavior -- no parity scenario/wire evidence wired). The vocabulary is open (classifiers may add codes such as an ABI validation-failure code); consumers must not assume this closed set.

detail.description: Optional free-text diagnostic. Not present in any real corpus report captured for this document.

unavailableReason.description: Present if and only if outcome is 'unavailable'.

kind.description: Append-only documented vocabulary (ADR 0013). Observed: effective-contract, semantic-model, declaration-projection. Also documented for behavior/abi once wired: parity-scenario, parity-wire, jvm-abi-dump, klib-abi-dump.

identity.description: Stable corpus/fixture/artifact/scenario identity. Never an absolute host path.

sha256.description: Canonical lowercase hex SHA-256 fingerprint of the referenced evidence.

location.description: Optional normalized location within the evidence (not an absolute host path).

id.description: compat-v1:<layer>:<subject-kind>:<digest16> -- deterministic, sortable, identical across JSON/Markdown/human renderings (ADR 0013, 'Stable change identifiers').

evidence.description: Never empty (CompatibilityChange enforces evidence.isNotEmpty() at construction).
